review_response_tasks.stem: Rosa is ____ three seeds into each pot now. (putting / put)
review_response_tasks.rationale: putting：is putting构成现在进行时。；put：is后不能直接接原形put构成此谓语。

review_response_tasks.stem: You should ____ the dry leaves into this basket. (puts / put)
review_response_tasks.rationale: puts：情态动词should后不用puts。；put：should后用动词原形put。

review_response_tasks.stem: Last month our class ____ how to grow beans. (learned / learnt)
review_response_tasks.rationale: learned：learned是合法过去式。；learnt：learnt是Oxford列明的合法过去式，同等接受。

review_response_tasks.stem: The class did not ____ any seeds last winter. (plant / planted)
review_response_tasks.rationale: plant：did not后用原形plant。；planted：did not后不接过去式planted。

review_response_tasks.stem: The path is ____ for the little wheelbarrow. (wide enough / enough wide)
review_response_tasks.rationale: wide enough：enough修饰形容词wide置于其后。；enough wide：这里不能使用enough wide。

review_response_tasks.stem: These beans came ____ our school garden. (from / at)
review_response_tasks.rationale: from：come from说明来源。；at：come at不表达这里的产地来源。

review_response_tasks.stem: Uncle gave the empty pots to my sister and ____. (I / me)
review_response_tasks.rationale: I：并列后仍作介词to的宾语，不能用主格I。；me：并列宾语my sister and me使用宾格me。

review_response_tasks.stem: The two pupils ____ the young plants when the teacher arrived. (were watering / waters)
review_response_tasks.rationale: were watering：复数主语two pupils与were watering一致。；waters：waters为第三人称单数，与复数主语不符。

review_response_tasks.stem: The children finished ____ the seed labels before lunch. (write / writing)
review_response_tasks.rationale: write：finish后不能在此接原形write。；writing：finish后接动名词writing。

review_response_tasks.stem: Please count the empty pots ____. (accurately / accurate)
review_response_tasks.rationale: accurately：accurately为副词，修饰count。；accurate：accurate为形容词，不在此修饰count。
